hints.title: Ordered BST Difference Property
hints.text: In a BST, the closest values to any node are its immediate inorder predecessor and successor.

hints.title: Single-Pass Inorder Traversal
hints.text: Traverse the tree in inorder (left, root, right) and track only the previous node value seen so far.

hints.title: Running Absolute Difference Minimum
hints.text: Initialize prev = None and min_diff = infinity. At each node in inorder traversal, compute node.val minus prev if prev is not None, update min_diff = min(min_diff, diff), and set prev = node.val.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Inorder traversal visits nodes in ascending order in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs of node values takes O(N^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking only the single predecessor value reduces memory to recursion stack O(H).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use inorder traversal to compare adjacent sorted values without sorting an array.
